GuardianBot: trigger fixed bottom-left (x=20, y near viewport bottom), opens panel with 4 starter buttons + input + send, starter click renders user msg immediately and assistant reply within 25s (Claude returned a real high-quality AC-diagnosis answer), localStorage 'joy_guardian_sid' persists 'grd_*' format, typed Enter flow works, reload restores prior conversation via /api/guardian/history (4 messages preserved). Both ChatWidget (bottom-right) and GuardianBot (bottom-left) coexist on Landing AND Dashboard without overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: Guardian rate-limit is in-memory (dict) — resets on backend restart. Acceptable per problem statement but for production scale move to Redis with TTL, otherwise multi-replica deployments will let abusive sessions through.

Guardian bot persists every visitor message+reply in MongoDB (db.guardian_messages) keyed by session_id with no TTL — recommend adding a periodic cleanup or Mongo TTL index on created_at to keep collection size bounded.

DashboardSearchBar fetches the entire /api/products list on first focus and filters client-side. Fine for current ~38 SKUs but will need a server-side ?q= search endpoint once catalogue exceeds a few hundred parts.
GuardianBot re-fetches history on every panel open (when messages.length===0) — fine, but the panel does not show a per-session 'Clear conversation' control. Minor UX gap.
Landing.jsx is still 1000+ lines (carried over from prior iters) — extract Hero, Tech, Value-prop into sub-components.
guardian.py reads EMERGENT_LLM_KEY at import-time into a module-level constant — if the .env is rotated the backend must be restarted to pick up the new key (acceptable but worth noting).
test_credentials: Workshop dashboard tested with Bearer test-token-workshop-1 / localStorage ja_session_token (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
